title: F. Maximum Reduction
statement:
Given an array $$a$$ of $$n$$ integers and an integer $$k$$ ($$2 $\leq k \leq n$$$), where each element of the array is denoted by $$a_i$$ ($$0 $\leq i  \lt  n$$$). Perform the operation $$z$$ given below on $$a$$ and print the value of $$z(a,k)$$ modulo $$10^{9}+7$$.

The first line of input contains two integers $$n$$ and $$k$$ ($$2 $\leq k \leq n \leq 10^6$$$) — the length of the initial array $$a$$ and the parameter $$k$$.

The second line of input contains $$n$$ integers $$a_0, a_1, \ldots, a_{n - 1}$$ ($$1 $\leq a_{i} \leq 10^9$$$) — the elements of the array $$a$$.

Output the only integer, the value of $$z(a,k)$$ modulo $$10^9+7$$.
